purpose: connect the sparse ISA dispatcher, direction-local DataMover engine, valid-ready stream bank adapters, and sparse local-memory subsystem while leaving vendor DataMover IP and GEMM arithmetic as explicit top-level boundaries

public_boundaries.vendor_datamover: both MM2S and S2MM command, payload, and status AXI-Stream interfaces are exposed unchanged
public_boundaries.gemm_control: dispatcher GEMM request and completion handshake are exposed to an external GEMM core; compute operands are banks and dimensions only, and the compatibility out_base_addr output is fixed to zero
public_boundaries.gemm_memory: ACT bank1 read, WGT bank2 read, and OUT bank3 read/write request ports are valid-ready; their read responses are ready-less valid pulses exactly three cycles after an accepted request
public_boundaries.diagnostics: engine fault/status diagnostics and all bank-subsystem error outputs remain observable

wiring_rules: dispatcher DMA command address, byte count, low 23 bits of byte offset, and bank connect to the matching DataMover engine direction; the dispatcher rejects any DMA command with nonzero local_offset bits 31 through 23 before acquisition
dispatcher DMA command tag is a bank identity and is not connected to the DataMover engine internal sequence tag
DataMover engine completion_bank connects to dispatcher s_ctrl direction status tag; completion_valid, completion_error_code, and completion_ready connect by direction
DataMover engine completion_tag and completion_received_tag remain external diagnostics for vendor status correlation
MM2S grant for bank i is asserted only when engine request i is high and bank i is busy with owner MM2S; only banks 0, 1, and 2 can grant
S2MM grant for bank 3 is asserted only when engine request 3 is high and bank 3 is busy with owner S2MM; every other S2MM grant is zero
each supported engine adapter start, abort, offset, payload, done, and ready signal connects only to its fixed-bank adapter instance
the three MM2S adapter write outputs share the bank-subsystem MM2S port through a fixed three-input one-hot mux; ready returns only to the selected valid adapter
the bank3 S2MM adapter connects directly to the bank-subsystem S2MM request/response port
dispatcher acquire and release vectors connect directly to bank_subsystem ownership inputs; bank state returns directly to dispatcher
GEMM control does not bypass dispatcher ownership; external GEMM memory traffic reaches only the typed ACT, WGT, and OUT ports of bank_subsystem
unsupported adapter-array entries are tied inactive and cannot generate a memory request

start_and_address_semantics.dispatcher_start: public cmd_dispatcher_start is a one-cycle pulse; holding it high across DONE or ERROR is forbidden because that requests an immediate new run
start_and_address_semantics.adapter_start: DataMover engine adapter start is a level held through the transaction until adapter done; the fabric must not edge-detect or pulse-shorten it
start_and_address_semantics.gemm_bank_base: ACT bank1 WGT bank2 and OUT bank3 native word address zero are implicit operation bases; GEMM does not accept a data-bank address operand
start_and_address_semantics.gemm_compatibility_out_base_addr: must be 32'd0 and may not be interpreted as a DDR or local-memory address

protocol_invariants: all valid-ready payloads remain stable while valid is high and ready is low
at most one MM2S adapter may assert bank_write_valid in a cycle
an engine grant implies both a matching engine request and matching bank ownership
DMA completion cannot release a bank from the vendor sequence tag; release identity comes only from completion_bank
no bank payload access occurs before the corresponding ownership acquisition is visible
END completes only after dispatcher pending operations and bank ownership drain
DataMover descriptor error codes 01 through 06 release the matching bank because no payload operation remains active
DataMover transport and recovery error codes 10 20 30 40 and 50 retain the matching pending bit and ownership until explicit recovery/reset; the fabric does not invent an automatic release
command BRAM is outside the data-bank namespace and is never bank 0
required_integration_tests: source identity and closed-source elaboration for every consumed child
command BRAM program MM2S bank1 then GEMM banks1/2/3 then S2MM bank3 then END
concurrent MM2S loads to different supported banks are accepted in program order without duplicate memory writes
vendor command backpressure and payload backpressure preserve command and data
MM2S payload reaches the selected bank exactly through packing and byte strobes
GEMM BFM reads exact ACT and WGT payloads and writes an exact OUT payload only while owners 3 4 5 are held
S2MM serializes the exact bank3 payload with correct keep and last
engine internal sequence tag differing from bank ID still releases the correct bank through completion_bank
invalid descriptor produces ordered error completion with no vendor command and no memory touch
DataMover transport fault holds the bank and requires recovery
reset, repeated program, END drain, and all sticky error outputs
Vivado XSIM, lint/elaboration, and 5 ns OOC synthesis with no black boxes or unconstrained clock paths
